args.title: Critical System Update Failure on Lenovo2 - Disk Space Warning and Update Service Unresponsive
args.description:
System log analysis reveals:
- Windows startup initiated
- Disk usage at 97% capacity
- Critical error: Update service not responding (code 0x80070005)
- User requested restart

This appears to be a system-level issue preventing software updates. Immediate IT attention required.
